host.description: The Player Plugin Host for Plugin API 2: plugin_state entries, contribution lifecycle, and service negotiation.

services.name: player.clock
services.description: Corrected server time, local and monotonic time, and plugin-owned timers.

services.name: player.events
services.description: Ephemeral typed events between a plugin's native and Shared Runtime parts: declared names, bounded payloads, never state.

services.name: player.media
services.description: Addresses for verified media variants that the plugin's current state entries declare.

services.name: player.presentation.observe
services.description: Read-only observation of what owns the screen and which item is shown.

services.name: player.presentation.provide
services.description: Registers a declared presentation provider. The host activates it for an external presentation that names it, and owns its visibility, lifecycle, and fallback.

services.name: player.reference.signal
services.description: Reference service that qualifies the native service model: one typed read of a counter the platform owns. No product Player provides it.

services.name: player.surface
services.description: Host-owned strip, corner, and overlay containers with claim arbitration and content-stage geometry.
